items.reason: GroupPermissionsV2.java:152 passes one concrete resource to evaluation; MgmtPermissions.java:335 wraps it in a singleton list. DecisionPermissionCollector.java:189-190 and :209-211 construct the returned permission using that same resource ID, so permissions for other group resources cannot appear as claimed.

GroupsResource.java:113 does perform per-group checks, but GroupPermissionsV2.java:141-152 deliberately uses all-groups permissions only when no group-specific resource exists. A global grant therefore cannot answer for every group: restoring the proposed shortcut would bypass group-specific restrictions, so these checks preserve authorization semantics.
